nodes.label: JRT Service Portal Landing Page – Need Help Screen
nodes.description: Browser screenshot of a service portal landing page. Top heading reads 'Need help? We'll be there in minutes.' with a subheading about getting your appointment booked. Left panel shows IEST branding with a 'JRT SERVICE PORTAL COMING SOON' banner featuring a badge indicating a 12-hour response time. Right panel shows a mobile OTP verification form ('Enter your mobile number') with a phone number input and 'Send OTP by SMS' CTA button. Bottom footer displays a phone number (+91 80891 50146) and support contact info, along with Call and WhatsApp action buttons. The page background is a soft green gradient.
